svg.title: Bridge schematic, sketch B: heatsink plate with puck devices

g.text: Physical layout: press-pack pucks on three heatsink columns, each puck a mini heat disc.

svg.text: Bus bars in gold-700; rings = heat stops reached by Tj (more rings, hotter). Thumbnail: pucks only, no chips.

g.text: Puck rings ← heat stops up to Tj
Ring count and outer colour from heat scale;
thyristor glyph engraved in the hub.
Pill under each puck; fault shows FAULT.
Gold ring + brackets + gold chip outline.
Bus bars: L1–L3 in, DC± out
Static; armature A live at the DC output.
Fill = heat stop of Tj. Icon + word carry status.
Fault: hatch, dashed outline, no heat colour.
